m: The {Magician} on the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} pulls a stalk of *prickly grass* from his hat, and its bristly **awn** shoots out like a spear, jabbing a pilot in the bottom. He pulls another, and another, until the stairs bristle with **awns** like a porcupine. The pilots climb up wearing oven gloves, yelping at every step.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} juggles a *bamboo* pole and a giant *rib* from last night's barbecue. The rib snaps back like a slingshot, held by a stretchy **tendon**, and fires a dumpling across the street. He plucks the **tendon** like a guitar string and serenades the innkeeper with a twangy ballad.

The {Pirate} bursts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} and whispers into a *knight*'s *ear*: "I'll **employ** you as my cabin boy." The knight clanks, bows and starts swabbing the floor in full armour. By lunch the pirate has **employed** the cook, the cat and a goose, all on a salary of biscuits.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} goes fishing with a golden *hook*, baiting it with *gold coins*. She casts it into the lake, and a whale bites, then a submarine, then the moon's reflection. Every catch dangles from the **hook**, and she reels in the whole lake on one gleaming **hook**.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} holding a *tree* branch with an *insect* clinging to it. She strips the leaves and turns it into a **stick**, which the insect uses to pole-vault onto the roulette table. It wins every spin; the croupier confiscates the lucky **stick**.

The {Robot} in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} puts on an *embroidered robe* and opens a huge metal *mouth*. It starts to **shout** commands: "TAKE OFF! LAND! MORE OIL!" The planes taxi back and forth in panic. The mechanics plug their ears, but the robot only **shouts** louder, rattling every rivet.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a cave where a *wellspring* bubbles under the *moon*. Every time a banker sweats, a tiny **gland** in his neck squirts like a water pistol. The Shepherd collects the drops in a bucket; every **gland** in the exchange is working overtime on market day.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and strings a *bow* with a *dark thread* pulled from his sock. He plucks the **string** and a deep note booms through the vault, making the coins jingle. Bankers dance, the gold bars hum, and he plucks the **string** again to stop the stock market.

The {Yogi} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a *trap pit* where a roaring *campfire* sits at the bottom. She lands cross-legged right in the **flame**, perfectly calm, toasting marshmallows on her fingertips. The butler peers down; each breath she takes makes the **flame** dance higher.

The {Sheriff} in the {Basement} of the {Water Park} meets a *woman* with a *beard* down to her knees. She lets him **play with** it: he braids it, swings on it, and slides down it like a water slide. The lifeguards join in, everyone wants to **play with** the beard.

The {Firefighter} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} climbs onto the shoulders of a *standing person* who is so tall he pokes through the ceiling into a *mansion* above. She has to **look down** at the swimmers, tiny as ants. Everyone in the mansion **looks down** at her through the hole, waving teacups.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} measures a tiny *village* tucked under a *cliff*. It is one **hundredth** the size of a normal village; the houses are thimbles and the mayor rides a snail. She blows her whistle and everyone in the village shrinks to one **hundredth** again.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} and lands in front of a *standing heart* doing the cha-cha. She can only **stare blankly**, whistle half in her mouth. The monkeys **stare blankly** too, and a parrot forgets every word it ever knew.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} onto a *cliff* where the *summer* sun has grown a skyscraper out of the rock. The **tall building** keeps rising, floor after floor, until the spa guests in their robes take the elevator to sunbathe in the clouds. Swallows nest in the top of the **tall building**.

The {King} in the {Basement} of the {Funfair} fixes everyone with a fierce *glare*, but his *heart* is full of hope. He kneels before the candy-floss seller and makes an **earnest** plea for the last pink cloud. His voice trembles, his crown wobbles; nobody has ever been so **earnest** about sugar.

The {Robot} on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} holds an *emperor* captive and threatens him with a *side dish* of cold broccoli. The emperor begs: "**Spare** me!" The robot beeps, considers, and decides to **spare** him, but only if he eats the carrots.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} hammers a giant *nail* into the roof with a sack of *gold coins*. Each strike rings like a gong, and the boxers below duck. The **nail** sinks through the ring and the floor, all the way to China. The Dentist pulls it out with his pliers; the **nail** has a tooth on it.

The {Gardener} in the {Basement} of the {Water Park} looks up at the *roof*, where only a **few** raindrops fall through a crack: drip, drip, drip. The giant slides are dry, the pools are empty, and the visitors are **few**: one duck, one tourist and one lonely inflatable flamingo.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and the moose he chased escapes through the window. His *standing heart* sinks and he weeps big *tears* into his hat. "What a **pity**," sighs the butler, and the moose, waving from the lawn, agrees: such a **pity**.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Wine Cellar} hauls up a *dragnet* full of barrels with a *helping hand*. Then he **throws down** the whole net, and barrels bounce and roll down the hill, crashing into the vineyard. The farmer **throws down** his hat in fury.

The {Dentist} on the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} watches the *leaf pickers* bring in leaves and the yeti fold each one like a *folded blanket*. They **pile up** leaf after leaf, until the stack touches the cave roof. The yeti climbs to the top to sleep, and the dentist keeps **piling up** blankets.

The {Robot} in the {Basement} of the {Hut} meets a *lookalike*, another robot with an identical face, and its *heart* starts to buzz with jealousy. It pokes the lookalike, beeps rudely and steals its oil can to **provoke** it. The lookalike pokes back; they **provoke** each other until the hut explodes in sparks.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a *dugout canoe* where a giant *mouth* is teaching. "Life is like a canoe," it booms, "it floats till it sinks." That is an **analogy**. The Yogi paddles the canoe through the museum, and every exhibit offers its own **analogy**.

The {Pirate} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} unrolls a **chart** in *broad daylight* that streams through a crack. A *small speech bubble* rises from every note on the music **chart**, singing sea shanties. The pirate conducts with his cutlass, and the swimmers above join in.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and a *ghost* floats out of the magazine rack and taps his *standing heart*. "You jumped the queue," it moans. The King turns crimson, feeling deeply **ashamed**, and walks to the back of the line, still **ashamed**, apologizing to every patient.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Swamp} finds a *golden crown* glowing in a crackling *campfire*. It is so **radiant** that frogs turn gold and the mud shimmers. He puts it on, and he becomes **radiant** too, lighting the swamp like a lighthouse.

The {Hunter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} follows a trail of muddy *footsteps* across the tiles to a shiny **badge** glued to the chimney. He pins it on, and instantly every patient below salutes, the receptionist calls him Captain, and the doctor sees him first. The jealous dog follows the footsteps back, hoping to find its own **badge**.

The {Robot} on the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} drops a sugar cube into a glass *container* of *water drops* and watches it **dissolve** with a fizz. Fascinated, it drops in a screwdriver, its antenna, then its whole left arm. Everything **dissolves** in a cloud of bubbles, and the robot beeps nervously as its foot slips toward the glass.

The {Jockey} yanks the {Trapdoor} lever in the {Waiting Room}, and an entire football *team* in muddy kits drops through the floor. They **fall** in slow motion, cleats first, and land in a pile of fresh *soil* below, sprouting like turnips. Then the receptionist **falls**, then the potted fern, then the jockey's horse, still reading a magazine.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} sits by glowing *embers*, telling a ghost story. Just as he reaches the scary part, a bucket of water hisses over the coals, and the story is **cut short**. Everyone groans, and he tries again, but the sauna timer rings and it's **cut short** again.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} juggles wet *towels* in a thunderstorm. Each **towel** soaks up more rain, getting heavier and heavier, until one flops onto a pigeon. The pigeon dries itself off, bows, and hands him back a perfectly folded **towel**.

The {Lifeguard} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and *water drops* gush out, filling every room. An *inspector* in a raincoat arrives with a clipboard: the bathtubs are **overflowing**, the sinks are **overflowing**, even the teapots. He floats away on his clipboard, writing a report.

The {Sailor} in the {Basement} of the {Spa} spots a *bird nest* above the hot pipes and cranks the valve. *Water drops* **spray** everywhere, soaking the birds, who **spray** back with their wings like sprinklers. The spa guests think it is a new treatment and pay double.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} watches a *busy man* shovel heaps of *soil* into the drain. Every pipe gets **blocked up** with mud and the pool overflows. The dentist grabs his drill and tries to unblock it, but the man keeps **blocking up** every hole.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} past a *queue* of bees carrying shiny white *tiles*. They are building a palace of fine **porcelain**, every cell gleaming. The Tsar taps one; it chimes like a bell. He orders a **porcelain** crown, and it immediately cracks.

The {Jockey} slams the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and a crowd of tiny mouths around a *small table* start to *chatter* in Latin. They are casting a **spell**: the oars turn to snakes, the boats to geese. The Jockey shouts "Cancel!" and the **spell** reverses, but now his horse is a canoe.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} meets a *woman* in a feathered hat and a *bowman*'s quiver: her **aunt**, the family's champion archer. She fires arrows that pop every beach ball and pins sandwiches to the lifeguard's chair. Then she hands everyone sweets and pinches their cheeks. Nobody dares refuse this **aunt**.

The {Baker} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} carrying a *tree* trunk as a *tribute* for the pilot king. The trunk is carved into a huge wooden **club**, and the king swings it like a baseball bat, sending a helicopter flying. The Baker bows, and asks for his **club** back.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes} onto a sandy *hillside* where a *lord* sits on a throne. He waves at the horizon: "This whole **county** is mine." The juggler juggles sand to divide it into fields, and the lord names each one after himself, so the **county** is very confusing.

The {Yogi} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a misty *valley* filled with warm *water drops*. She takes a long **bath** among the dinosaur bones and the statues follow her lead. Soon the whole museum takes a **bath**, and the mummy unwraps to soak.

The {Magician} rises out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} and meets a *woman* with one *raised brow*. She is so **charming** that fish leap to fetch her flowers and the swans curtsey. He tries to make her disappear, but she just smiles; he is the one who vanishes, it is that **charming**.

The {Sailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} finds a dried-up *fish* lying by a *grain stalk*. He dips the stalk in water and sprinkles the fish, which flips, gasps, and starts to **revive**. It sits up, does a backflip into the pool, and **revives** the whole aquarium with a song.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Wine Cellar} follows a trail of *water drops* and a chirping *sparrow* into a secret tunnel. It opens onto the wide **Huai River**, flowing between north and south China. He sails a wine barrel down the **Huai River**, and the sparrow steers.

The {Ghost} floats over the {Rooftop} of the {Island} and a huge *mouth* pops out of a bush of *mugwort* yelling "**Hey**!" The ghost jumps right out of its sheet. The mouth yells "**Hey**!" again, and now the whole island is shouting at each other.

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and lands beside a *lying man* sunbathing with *twins* on either side. Suddenly a thunderous **fart** shakes the sand. The twins point at each other; the lying man floats an inch in the air from the next **fart**, and the pirate holds his nose.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} taps a *lacquer tree* and *water drops* of sticky red sap drip into her pom-poms. She paints everything with glossy **lacquer**: the chimney, the seagulls, her shoes. Then she slips on her own **lacquer** and skates off the roof.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Inn} watches a *greedy claw* poke through the ceiling, grabbing every *water drop* that leaks from the bathtub upstairs. It hoards bucket after bucket, then the soup, then the fish tank: wildly **excessive**. The buckets overflow and the stairs become a waterfall. The innkeeper paddles past in a pot, scolding such **excessive** greed.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} finds a giant bird's **nest** built from spaghetti. A *nest* of eggs sits inside, and the mother bird glares at him. He cooks a tiny omelette as an apology and the bird lets him nap in the **nest**.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} with a megaphone shaped like a giant *mouth*, slicing a *cut cake* with her axe. She bellows **orders**: "You, ride the coaster! You, eat this slice! You, spin faster!" Everyone obeys at once. The Ferris wheel whirls, crumbs fly, and the clowns salute and beg for more **orders**.

The {Jockey} pops out of the {Trapdoor} at the {Swan Pond}, where a *kneeling pair* of swans holds up a quill like a sword. He takes it in a *helping hand* and begins to **compose** an epic: "O swan, thy neck so long, thy honk so wrong." The swans, offended, snatch the quill back and **compose** a scathing review in honks.

The {Shepherd} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and a *stern face* on the wall puckers its *mouth*. It begins to **whistle**, one long piercing note that rises and rises. Cats fly off shelves, teacups crack, and the milk curdles. The Shepherd fights back: he puts two fingers in his mouth and **whistles** louder, and his sheep come running.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} into a pool where *water drops* have stopped moving. A *belt* is tied round the pond to keep it still: totally **stagnant**. Bees grumble and the jockey's horse sniffs the **stagnant** water and refuses to drink.

The {Magician} on the {Staircase} of the {Lake} castle waves his *cane* at a *king*, and a red **rose** blooms from the tip. He pulls another, and another, until the king is buried in petals. Thorns poke the king, who sneezes; even his sneezes smell of **rose**.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and lands on a huge *stone* tablet carved with a single *page* of tiny writing. It is his diploma: a **master's degree** in advanced lassoing. He lassos a forklift to celebrate, and the cows in the warehouse line up in caps and gowns to toast his **master's degree**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} with a rod made from a soup *ladle* and a line baited with *gold coins*. He sets out to **fish** in the giant milk bowl and hooks a tabby, then a cupcake, then the barista. The cats, insulted, grab tiny rods and start to **fish** for his teeth.

The {Dentist} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} and lifts a pile of *leaves* to find a shy *bug* curled up underneath. It stretches, unfolds, and keeps unfolding into a **butterfly** with wings as wide as a carpet. The yeti chases it with a net, but the **butterfly** lands on the yeti's nose and fans him to sleep.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} trips on the root of a *lacquer tree* under the full *moon* and bangs his **knee**. It swells up like a red balloon and glows sticky and shiny. He sits down groaning, and his sheep queue up to bounce on his **knee** like a trampoline, baa-ing with delight.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower}, where a *woman* hands her a *cracked shell* with a name scratched on it: **Yao**. On every landing someone else waves the same shell. The plumber is Yao, the baby is Yao, even the parrot squawks its name. The Yogi gives up and writes **Yao** on her own forehead.

The {Magician} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and tall *grass* bursts out, so thick a gardener must hack it with a *pole axe*. It grows back **luxuriant** and green faster than he can chop. Soon the tower is a jungle, the most **luxuriant** in town.

The {Cheerleader} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Museum}, where an ancient marble *torso* is wrapped in a *district map*. She copies every street onto her own **body** in marker, from her ankles to her ears, and cartwheels across the roof. Lost tourists come up and read directions off her **body**: "Café? Left elbow, then down the shin."

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and nearly squashes a tiny *clerk* at a desk in the sand. He is the **minor official** in charge of waves, stamping a permit for each one before it may break. The sea waits impatiently. She bribes him with an ice cream, and the **minor official** stamps the whole ocean at once.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Mint} meets a *prowling dog* in a *long robe* who turns out to be an **ape**. It swings from the coin presses, counts gold with its toes, and steals her yoga mat. The **ape** then does a perfect handstand.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} and lands beside a *bare tree*, sharpened to a point. Then he sees a hundred more, standing shoulder to shoulder in a ring: a wooden **stockade**. Pirates peer over the top with spyglasses. His horse takes a run-up and leaps clean over the **stockade** into the pirates' lunch.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and hears an *echo* from deep below: his *heart* is begging. He decides to **forgive** the robber who stole his hat. The echo repeats "**forgive**!" so loudly that the robber cries and hands back the hat.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Staircase} of the {Museum} grabs a shovel and digs a **canal** right through the exhibits, past mummies and dinosaurs. A *tree* sprouts beside the *canal* and gondolas glide under its branches. She chants from the prow of each boat, and the **canal** finally pours into the café, flooding the cappuccinos.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} hosts a family reunion: a *pole axe* to cut the cake and a bowl of *soybean* snacks. **Relatives** arrive by boat, by plane, by cannon. She cheers for each, but the **relatives** keep arriving until the roof collapses.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair}, and on the fifth step a giant *clam* yawns open with a dragon curled inside, holding a clock that points to dragon-hour. "I am the **fifth Earthly Branch**," it booms, and breathes on the candy floss. The Chef serves it chowder, and the **fifth Earthly Branch** demands a seat on the dodgems.

The {Baker} on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} watches an enormous *boat* sail into the harbour, towed by a single *white dove* tugging a ribbon. It is an ocean-going **ship**, heavier than the fort, piled with flour sacks. The dove lands on his hat, exhausted. The Baker bakes the dove a loaf and the whole **ship** a cake.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} slices an enormous *cut cake* and slips a *page* of certificates into every slice. He **issues** them to every guest by catapult: best moustache, loudest sneeze, most polite pigeon. The butler, who is **issued** only a crumb and a blank page, sulks behind the chimney.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Swamp} hut watches the swamp king's *golden crown* slip from his hand and sink into the mud. His *standing heart* pounds with **anxiety**, leaping out of his chest to pace up and down. Frogs croak with **anxiety** too. He dives in, and the crown bobs up, wearing a frog.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Pool} spots a *prowling dog* carrying a *melon*. It is actually a **fox** in disguise! It cracks the melon, eats it and winks. The **fox** dives into the pool and swims away with the hunter's hat.

The {Firefighter} in the {Basement} of the {Jungle} hut hears a *small speech bubble* blown in on the *wind*: "Nice hose, hero, did it come with water?" The parrots **satirize** her rescue, imitating her helmet. She sprays them, and they **satirize** that too.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} and plants *bamboo* upside down, *roots* waving in the air like hair. The crowd laughs: what a **dumb** idea. But the bamboo grows down, then sideways, then loops into a roller coaster. He rides it proudly, still looking **dumb**, waving a baguette at the screaming crowd.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} with a mysterious *parcel*. Inside is one folded *shirt*, which he shakes out, and it keeps unrolling into a long silk **gown** that trails down twelve flights. He sweeps up the stairs like a queen, the hem dusting every step, and hides his cannonballs in the **gown**'s secret pockets.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} enters a *royal court* where a giant *mouth* hangs over the throne. It cackles and **ridicules** every dish he serves: "Soggy! Bland! Is this soup or bathwater?" So the Chef feeds it a ghost chili. The mouth turns tomato red, and now the whole court **ridicules** the mouth.

The {Firefighter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house unrolls her hose, but instead of water it gushes hot black *coffee*. She sprays the whole lake until it steams and smells of roasted beans. The fish start swimming at double speed, the ducks quack in fast-forward, and a frog orders a **coffee** with oat milk. Nobody in town sleeps that week: too much **coffee**.

The {Pirate} on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} stands on a *launch pad* and fires a barrel of *water drops* into the sky. It bursts overhead and he **splashes** the enemy ship, the seagulls and his own captain. Delighted, he loads another barrel and **splashes** the fort's flag until it droops like a soggy sock.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} to a busy *crossroads* of traders, where his sheepdog sits with *gold coins* stacked between its teeth. It refuses to drop them; it will only **hold in mouth**. The bankers hold coins in their mouths too, and every deal is mumbled. Even the Shepherd tries to **hold in mouth** his crook.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mint} and finds a *standing person* reading an endless *scroll* of coin numbers aloud. He has been reading for nine years, yawning between digits, utterly **weary**. The Juggler offers to help, reads two lines, and collapses snoring onto a pile of pennies, equally **weary**.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} holding a magic bottle that can **contain** anything. He uncorks it and *water drops* from the whole flooded hall rush in: the bathtub, the fountain, the goldfish, a rubber duck. Then he tries to **contain** the butler, who waves furiously from inside the glass.

The {Cheerleader} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} and spots a *sparrow* skating in circles. She lifts it with a gentle *pinch*, the tiniest **small bird** in the world, no bigger than a thimble. It trills a cheer, does a triple axel, and the crowd tosses roses to the **small bird**, burying it completely.

The {Shepherd} counts sheep on the {Staircase} of the {Dunes} lighthouse, one per step, and each step is *ten days* long. He marks off a **ten-day period** on the wall with chalk, then another. By the top of the stairs his beard has grown into the sand, and he has counted thirty **ten-day periods** and only four sheep.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} meets a *standing person* just back from a frozen *borderland*, stiff as a plank. He is completely **rigid**: arms out, legs locked, frost in his eyebrows. The Juggler tips him over and uses him as a bridge between two stands, and the fans walk across, the man still **rigid** as a board.

The {Sailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} grabs a honeycomb with his *helping hand* and starts *tearing* it in half. Honey sprays everywhere. The bees **tear** his trousers in revenge, then his hat, then his map. He jumps into the river, his clothes **torn** to ribbons, buzzing all the way.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} sees a *branch* glowing under the *moon*. It grows an elbow, then a wrist, then fingers: a new **limb**! It waves, grabs his reins, and steers the horse. By dawn the hive has sprouted a **limb** on every side, and it crawls away like a giant honey spider.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut hears a rumble, and a *dragon* bursts through the floor, ploughing the *soil* with its tail. It leaves a long raised **crop row**, then another, as neat as stripes on a shirt. She plants carrots along each **crop row**, and the dragon waters them with gentle steam.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} watches a *bowman* paddle ashore in a canoe painted with rising suns. He is a warrior of the **eastern tribes**, and his arrows trail ribbons of sea mist. More canoes follow, drumming, and the **eastern tribes** set up camp on the stairs, offering the Yogi grilled fish.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and catches a *rabbit* digging a tunnel under her mat. It bolts down the coastal *road*, ears flapping, determined to **escape**. She chases it in lotus position, bouncing like a beach ball, but it **escapes** onto a passing surfboard and waves goodbye.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} and waves his wand over the *grass* in a window box. It shoots up into tall **reeds**, sharp as a *spear*, rustling and whistling. He weaves them into a thatched roof in seconds, and the tower now wears a hat of **reeds** that birds immediately move into.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} meets a *standing person* tottering on enormous *stilts*, a suitcase in each hand. He is an **emigrant** who walked across the ocean on stilts to open a café abroad. She cheers his arrival, the cats help unpack, and the **emigrant** serves tea from the top of his stilts.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Museum} sets up a soapbox and asks a question about dinosaurs. Instantly **the public** floods in: tourists, schoolkids, grannies, a mime, all shouting opinions at once. They vote, argue, and carry her up the stairs on their shoulders. Whatever she says, **the public** answers louder.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} to a hot *cave* at the top where a glowing **kiln** roars. She slides a *clay jar* inside, then meditates on the doorstep while it bakes. The jar pops out shiny and blue, then the **kiln** fires out a whole tea set, and finally her sandals, glazed.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} into a pit of *black mud* bubbling with *water drops*. He climbs out dyed jet black from head to toe; the perfect disguise. The yeti, jealous, jumps in too and comes out soaked in **black dye**. Now two black ninjas sneak around, and one of them is enormous and covered in **black dye**.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} through tall *grass* and finds a fuzzy brown *cattail* growing out of the diving board. He snaps the **cattail** and uses it as a microphone, then a sword, then a torch. The swimmers find him sword-fighting the lifeguard with a **cattail** in each hand.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} carries *two sheaves* of golden wheat, and a *small speech bubble* floats above her saying "oh, it's nothing." She has just saved the economy, but she is so **modest** she hands the medals to a pigeon. The bankers cheer; she bows, too **modest** to look up.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and finds a weeping willow *tree* wearing a scholar's *high collar*. It points him to a misty lake with pagodas and tea fields: he has landed in **Hangzhou**! He paddles across West Lake in a teacup, and the willow sighs poems about **Hangzhou** all night.

The {Ghost} floats over the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} and gets lost in a hedge *maze*, wailing round and round. At last a giant *mouth* in the hedge explains: "Turn left at the gargoyle." "**Oh, I see**!" says the ghost, and floats straight through the walls anyway. The mouth groans; the ghost waves: "**Oh, I see**!"

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and bandages a leaking sandcastle with *rags* and *grass*. It holds, but the **drawback** is that every crab moves into it and pinches him. Another **drawback**: the grass sprouts and the whole castle walks away like a hairy turtle.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Dunes} hotel watches an *employee* with a *strong arm* lift a falling camel off a tourist. The manager pins a giant gold star on him for **merit**. The camel, impressed, gives him its hump too. The employee flexes, and the **merit** star blinds three passing pilots.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} grabs a *standing knife* and starts to **scrape** moss off the slides. The moss fights back, sticking out a long green *tongue*. She **scrapes** harder, sparks fly, and the slide becomes so slippery that swimmers shoot off the end into the sky.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} sits with *crossed legs* and looks past the city to a green *hillside* in the **suburbs**. He juggles a cat, a cushion and a lawnmower, then hops a bus. In the **suburbs** everyone mows lawns in unison, and the cat moves into a garden gnome.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} watches *icicles* grow on a fisherman's *wife* as she waits for his boat in the snow. Her song is so **mournful** that the seagulls weep and the waves stop to listen. The Cheerleader tries a chant, but it comes out **mournful** too, all minor keys.

The {Pirate} in the {Basement} of the {Jungle} temple reaches a *helping hand* toward a glowing *tribute* of rubies laid before the stone idol. They are blazing hot, so he has to **cup** them in both palms, blowing and hopping like a man holding soup. The idol frowns; he gently **cups** the rubies back onto the altar and tiptoes out.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} into a bathtub as big as a lake, full of warm *water drops*. He decides to **soak** for just a minute, still juggling. Hours pass. His fingers wrinkle into raisins, his juggling balls swell into watermelons, and the innkeeper tops up the tub so he can **soak** until breakfast.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion watches a swan pedal a giant *spindle* that spins a lump of *stone* into a perfect red **brick**, then another, then a thousand. The swans honk orders and lay them in rows. Before he can whistle for his horse, the last **brick** clicks into place and he is walled in.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} finds a great bronze **cauldron** on three sturdy *cauldron legs*, a huge painted *eye* blinking on its belly. It bubbles with soup. He dips a spoon in, and the **cauldron** stands up, winks, and stomps upstairs into the ring to challenge the champion, spilling broth on every punch.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} with a woven *bamboo* **basket**, and a fussy *inspector* blocks her way with a magnifying glass. He rummages through it: a kitten, a lobster, a trumpet, the duke's missing crown. The inspector faints from surprise, so she folds him up neatly and pops him into the **basket** as well.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} lodge stuffs *grass* into a bamboo basket over a bonfire, and *rising steam* billows up into clouds. He means to **steam** a few dumplings, but the cloud swallows his horse. When it clears, the horse is pink, puffy and smells of pork buns. Monkeys queue to **steam** their bananas.

The {Baker} in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} rolls out dough as wide as the ring and slaps it onto *linked rails* glowing like a grill. With a *side dish* of jam, it sizzles into a **flat cake** that the boxers practise their punches on, flattening it thinner and thinner. By the final bell the **flat cake** is so thin you can read through it.

The {Magician} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} lifts the *lid* off a shoebox and a tiny *rice field* unrolls across the floor, growing and growing until it covers exactly one **mu** of land. Farmers in straw hats wade in, planting seedlings between surprised swimmers. He measures it with his wand: one **mu**, not a grain more.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} clutching a prize from the ring toss: a squishy bean-shaped balloon, a giant **kidney**, glowing pink under the *moon*. It bounces off the carousel, the dodgems and the strongman. Children chase it shrieking, and the Sheriff lassoes his runaway **kidney** just before it floats over the Ferris wheel.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} finds a *hillside* rising inside it so **steep** it goes straight up the wall. A *runner* in spiked shoes sprints up it, slides back down, and tries again. The Dentist drills toeholds for him, but every time he finishes, the hill gets even **steeper** and tips its hat.

The {Jockey} in the {Basement} of the {Tower} hears scratching, and a giant *talon* punches through the brick wall, groping for his cap. It is an eagle's **claw**, as big as a garden rake. He bravely offers it a sausage. The **claw** takes it delicately, then shakes his hand with great politeness and withdraws, crunching.

The {Tailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and a *rabbit* in swimming goggles springs out of the deep end. It does a perfect lap of backstroke, then steals his measuring tape and sews itself a striped swimsuit. By evening every **rabbit** in town is queuing at his shop, and he measures each **rabbit**'s ears.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} holds up a polished *mirror body* as a heavy *war club* swings at her. The club's reflection jumps out as a second club, then a fourth, then a hundred, and each one turns into a plate of food as it lands. The feast is **plentiful**: dumplings, mangoes, roast ducks, far more **plentiful** than the inn can hold.

The {Jockey} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} to visit an *oracle* in a striped tent. She stares into a cracked bowl and declares he must remain **chaste** and pure until he wins the Derby. He blushes, refuses every candy apple and every kiss-me booth, and the clowns crown him the most **chaste** jockey ever.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} onto a pile of *grass*, and a *piggy bank* in his lap squeaks: "I **recommend** gold!" He buys gold and gets rich. "I **recommend** tulips!" He buys tulips and gets richer. Now he follows the pig everywhere, and the bankers line up to ask its advice.

The {Yogi} in the {Basement} of the {Spa} wins a *silver medal* in the silence championship. She opens her *mouth* to give a speech, and nothing comes out: she has gone completely **mute**. She mimes her thanks, the judges mime applause, and the steam room becomes so **mute** that you can hear the bubbles in the hot tub.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a cellar heaped with black *charcoal*, coughing in the dust. Inspired, he sews himself a whole suit of **charcoal**, buttons and all, and strides upstairs like a walking shadow. Guests faint, the curtains get smudged, and the cat now has **charcoal** whiskers.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair}'s haunted house and finds a **grave** of fresh mounded *soil*, its headstone covered in a skull *tattoo*. The earth rumbles, and a rickety roller coaster rises out of the **grave**, screaming. She blasts it with her hose, and the soggy ride rattles off toward the dodgems.

The {Jockey} in the {Basement} of the {Spa} kneels by his bike's *flat tyre* when a giant *eye* opens on the wall and begins to **blink**. Each **blink** puffs out a gust of steam like a bellows, and the tyre inflates, wheeze by wheeze. He thanks the eye; it winks, and the tyre bursts.

The {Baker} on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} reads a *proclamation* nailed to the door: whoever wins the duel owns the bakery. He rolls up his sleeves, grabs a baguette in his *helping hand*, and starts to **fight** a knight in full armour. They **fight** step by step down the staircase, crumbs and sparks flying, until the knight surrenders for a croissant.

The {King} on the {Staircase} of the {Hut} opens his *mouth* to make a royal speech, and a hairy *wild boar* charges out. He begins to **cough**, and with every **cough** another snorting boar tumbles out and thunders down the stairs. Soon the hut is full of pigs, and the court doctor hands him a cough drop the size of a turnip.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} finds the scales of a *dragon* scattered across the floor like sequins. With a giant *helping hand* she begins to **draw together** every scale, sweeping them into a shimmering heap. They click into place, and the reassembled dragon purrs, rolls over, and helps her **draw together** the floating pool noodles.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} into a kitchen where a burly *man* is pounding chilies in a huge stone *mortar*. It's his **maternal uncle**, his mum's brother, cooking his famous curry for forty backpackers. Fire alarms wail, the hostel cat sneezes, and the **maternal uncle** ladles out bowls that make everyone cry.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} cabin just as the *sun* sinks behind a skinny *sapling*. It gets **dark**, then darker, until he can't find his own hat. He conjures a lamp: it lights up black. He conjures fireflies: they glow black too. Everything he summons comes out **dark**.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and starts tossing hay bales into a tall *silo* with one *helping hand*. Every bale sails in perfectly, swish. He is so **good at** it that the butler applauds, so the Sheriff tosses the butler in too. Turns out he is also very **good at** apologizing.

The {Sheriff} in the {Basement} of the {Swamp} hut meets a *big man* wrapped in *crisscross* bandages, groaning. The Sheriff unwinds him like a mummy, and with every loop the fog lifts, until the swamp is **bright and clear** and sparkling. The frogs blink in the sunlight, and the big man stretches, feeling **bright and clear** for the first time in years.

The {King} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} opens a **café** with a door shaped like a giant *mouth* and a menu that is one big *plus sign*: every order comes doubled. Double espresso, double cake, double cream. Guests in fluffy robes queue round the roof, and the King, wearing an apron over his robes, steams milk for the busiest **café** in town.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} reaches a long *helping hand* into the *loft* to **put** away her flowerpots. Then she **puts** in the cat, the dog, the chickens and a startled postman, stacking them neatly like jars. The loft creaks, groans and finally bursts, and everything rains down onto the vegetable patch.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a *small altar* holding a dusty *logbook* that records her **official salary**: one sardine a day. She complains so loudly that the altar rumbles and the page rewrites itself. Now her **official salary** is two sardines and a free swim.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} and finds a fierce *sparrow* standing on *this spot*, guarding three speckled eggs. She is a **female** sparrow who bosses the bees around like a general. The queen bee, also **female**, flies over, and the two ladies shake wings and order the Tsar to fetch worms.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a gallery where an old *portrait* has puckered its painted *mouth*. Every time someone tiptoes past, it blows a shrill **whistle**: wheeeet! The guards come running. The Sheriff glares at it; the portrait winks and blows the **whistle** again just to annoy him.

The {Gardener} in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut sees a crack running up the wall and hammers in a wooden *brace* to **secure** it. Then she braces the wobbly table, the leaky boat and the dog, who keeps trying to walk off. When the storm hits, everything she **secured** stands firm while the roof sails away.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mint} and a fat *silkworm* spins a glimmering *silk thread* round and round until it forms a sheet of **thin silk**. It is so light he juggles it like a cloud. The mint starts printing money on it, and banknotes of **thin silk** float out of the windows like kites.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} and spots a *bug* tucked in a *yarn pile*, wound up in spirals: a **snail**. It inches up the steps leaving a glittering trail. She cheers it on with her whistle, but three days later the **snail** has only reached step four and asks for a lift.

The {Gardener} in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} takes off her *robe* to **wrap** a giant *fruit* as a birthday present: a melon the size of a sofa. Then she **wraps** a pineapple, a bicycle and finally herself, rolling around in tape and ribbon until only her nose pokes out.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} hangs strips of *sun-dried meat* on a line. One sniff of the salty smell whisks him back into **the past**: he is a boy again, chasing lambs, losing his sandals in the waves. He bites a strip and the whole beach turns sepia, every gull flying through **the past**.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} hauls a creaking *cart* loaded with a *drying rack* up to a **high pavilion** perched on stilts above the city. He pegs freshly printed banknotes on the rack to dry in the wind. They flap like flags, and the pigeons start a bank in the **high pavilion**.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} and a *small speech bubble* flaps past on *soaring wings*, squawking "The moon is made of cheese!" Totally **erroneous**. He catches it in his hat, but another flies out: "Fish can knit!" The common room fills with flapping, **erroneous** bubbles.

The {Dentist} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} hidden under a costume of *leaves*, whispering a *small speech bubble* into his tooth microphone. He is a **spy**, here to steal the yeti's toothbrush. Then he discovers the yeti, also under leaves, is a **spy** too, spying on him.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} finds a **turtle** using a *bent knife* to scratch a *lightning bolt* onto its shell. It revs up and zooms across the tiles like a race car, leaving skid marks. The patients below hear thunder; the **turtle** wins every race and still waits politely for its appointment.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} meets a *woman* gasping for *breath*, dragging eleven suitcases up the steps: his new **daughter-in-law**, moving in with the family. She drops the bags and blows one huge breath that inflates every beach ball on the shore. The **daughter-in-law** has arrived, and so has her tuba.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} juggles a *sheep* and a knobby root, while a *woman* shouts that it is **ginger**. She grates it into the sheep's mouth mid-air. The sheep turns red, sneezes fire and rockets over the stadium like a woolly firework. The crowd chants for more **ginger**.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Piazza} gets a buzzing *pest* in his *eye* and staggers **blindly** about, flapping his crook. He walks **blindly** off the edge, bounces off a café awning, lands in the fountain, and the tourists, thinking it is a show, throw coins.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} finds a *rabbit* trapped under a *cloth cover* accused of stealing carrots, but the real thief is a goat chewing nearby. Such **injustice**! She whips off the cloth, the rabbit protests with a placard, and the two march round the roof chanting against the **injustice**.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} meets a big black *bird* with a gleaming vampire *fang*: a **crow** with attitude. It caws, snatches her fluffy towel and flies off cackling. The **crow** perches on the chimney wearing it like a cape, and the spa guests applaud the new mascot.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} temple and has a *chance meeting* with a lion lounging in tall *grass*. Both scream. The pirate's hair shoots up in every direction, utterly **disheveled**, his beard knotted like seaweed. The lion's mane is **disheveled** too; they borrow a comb from a passing monkey.

The {Shepherd} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} into a narrow *alley*, a **lane** so tight his sheep have to walk in single file. Behind him the whole flock squeezes in, bleating, wool scraping both walls. The **lane** fills from end to end with fluff like toothpaste, and the stadium cheers when they pop out the other end.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Inn} into a tiny indoor *grove* where a *king* sits polishing a **gem** the size of an egg. It flashes so brightly the trees grow sunglasses. She blows her whistle; the king, startled, drops the **gem**, and it bounces down every step, lighting up the inn like a disco.
